parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a value from your client to make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/ecs/developer-reference/how-to-ensure-idempotence).

parameters.name: ValidityPeriod
parameters.description: The time range of the validity period. This parameter is valid only when you set **ValidityType** to **time\_bound**.

parameters.name: ValidityType
parameters.description:
The validity period type. Valid values:

- permanent: The authorization is permanent.

- time\_bound: The authorization is valid for a custom time range.
